# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 and Graphite** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU backend bindings. The release also adds asynchronous pixel readback and a Silk.NET Vulkan package, while fixing native object lifetimes and improving Nano Server font support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through Chrome milestone m152** — Updates the bundled renderer with the m152 release, servicing fixes, and an upstream use-after-free fix. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Exposes Graphite backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can use Skia's newer GPU rendering architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — Adds backend-neutral RequestReadPixels support on SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronously retrieving pixels. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native object lifetimes corrected** — Prevents use-after-free failures when iterating regions or creating pixel-map subsets, and releases raster pixel memory when image creation fails. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Runtime-effect uniform buffers released on reset** — Disposes the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset, preventing native memory from accumulating. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-allocation data and text operations** — Avoids unnecessary copies when saving SKData and removes avoidable allocations while extracting encoded text and formatting four-byte tags. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))
- **Faster runtime-effect and handle lookup paths** — Reduces setup and reflection overhead when looking up runtime-effect uniforms and managed handles. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **Vulkan and Nano Server packages expanded** — Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Native debugging symbols packaged for Apple platforms** — Produces Apple native symbol packages during packing to improve symbol availability when diagnosing native issues. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves shaping and tag-formatting performance, and releases temporary stream assets after creating HarfBuzz blobs.
